text.content:
A ready-to-run boss arena for Umbrathor, the Shadow Tyrant (CR 18; the Level 8 / CR 13 variant uses the same layout with smaller radii). Everything below uses core Foundry only.

Scene skeleton: grid 100 px = 5 ft, about 56 × 38 squares (280 × 190 ft), background darkness level 0 (fully black), global illumination off, darkness color #0a0510.

Perimeter: standard walls, fully wrapped.

Entrance tunnel (north or east): thin walls with a locked stone door to control the party's entrance beat.

Collapsed passages (×2): thin walls sealing dead-end rubble tunnels.

Central dais: a standard-wall ring with a two-square gap for stairs — Umbrathor's lair-action origin.

Stalagmite clusters (4–6): terrain walls that block sight until a token has line-of-sight — natural shadow cover.

Key interplay: Umbrathor can Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness (Shadow Manipulation) and teleport 60 ft with Shadow Step. The terrain walls plus pitch-black default darkness mean he can genuinely vanish between turns.

Scene darkness stays at 0; every light below is a placed ambient light.

LightPositionBright/DimColorIntensityAnimation
Soul-lights ×4cave corners15 / 40#7a5cff0.4Light Framing, speed 3, intensity 5
Braziers ×4dais approach25 / 70#ff7a290.6Torch, speed 2, intensity 6
Shadow Hearton the dais60 / 120#3b2d6e0.5Pulse, speed 2, intensity 4

Claustrophobic Dark (regional effect): treat the darkness as magical — nonmagical light dims to dim light and darkvision cannot penetrate it. In Foundry terms: keep Darkness at 0, let the braziers and soul-lights be the only real light, and add no daylight.

Umbral Murk: dim-light areas are lightly obscured, and Umbrathor can emerge from any of them when using Shadow Step.

Token lights: Umbrathor 20/40 #2a1f4d intensity 0.35 slow Pulse; Shadows none; PCs none (their own darkvision/torches — the braziers become contested objectives).

Playlist: one looping dark ambient drone (volume ≈ 0.4) plus a combat stinger; keep the drone in ambient mode so it never cuts mid-fight.

Shadow Flood prop: pre-place a hidden 60-ft ambient light at the dais — color #3b2d6e, animation Chaos (speed 4, intensity 8) — and toggle it on when the lair action fires.

Darkness spell: the lair action's Darkness link needs no wiring; core spell animations carry it.

1. Drop Umbrathor from the The New Ragnarok Reborn — NPCs compendium onto the dais; summon Shadows around him (or fire Summon Shadows (1/Encounter)).
  2. Open his sheet and tick Inside Lair? — this applies the official +1 CR / +1 legendary action adjustment while he's in the cavern.
  3. Add a "Lair" combatant at initiative 20 (dnd5e 6.0.x doesn't auto-insert one). When count 20 comes up, roll one of the five lair actions from the sheet's Lair Actions section; the Lair Actions (Shadow Cavern) banner is the read-aloud script.
  4. Regional effects run passively: Claustrophobic Dark, fear whispers (DC 18 Wisdom for creatures below half HP at turn start), umbral murk.
  5. If Shadow Tendrils drops someone to 0 HP, spawn a Shadow on Umbrathor's next turn (CR 18 only).

Difficulty dials: soul-lights only for a scarier run; extra braziers for safer sight-lanes if the party is squishy.
